Designed for modern desks, this charger powers your whole digital lineup at the same time, from laptops to smartphones. For MacBook Air, 30W charging is available on the USB-C1 port only.
The single 30W max port charges a MacBook Air to 50% in 1 hour 40 minutes, or an iPhone 16 Pro Max from 0 to 50% in 30 minutes.
Three USB-C and three USB-A ports share a total output of 112W, which is enough for a wide range of devices.
A silicone cable organizer is included to keep cables from tangling and your workspace clear.
Anker Charger (112W, 6 Ports), cable organizer, welcome guide and a 12-month warranty.
